picks.reasoning: TSW's 25-2 LCP record is padded by a region that's soft on the world stage, where they're 1-6 against other regions, and LYON just beat them 3-0 at MSI. Berserker's 27% damage share is the kind of individual carry that wins a single game, and I'm not paying for TSW's hype.

TSW owns the early map: +1.6k at 15, 85% first towers, and 55% first dragons against LYON's +0.8k, 70%, and 47%. LYON's 3-0 sweep at MSI is a warning, but TSW's first-15-minute control should decide this one.

TSW's LCP numbers are elite, but their international record is 1-6 against other regions and they lost to LYON 3-0 at MSI, so I read their draft pool as strong only when the early game goes their way. LYON's MSI 3-2 and their comeback habit (11 objectives taken while 1k+ behind) give them more ways to win a Fearless draft that stops TSW's early snowball.

TSW's LCP numbers are stronger on paper (+1.6k GD@15, 26-8 series), but their international record is 1-6 against other regions and they dropped the last three games. LYON has the better cross-region record (4-6), a better recent run (7 wins in their last 10), and beat TSW 3-0 at MSI, so I lean LYON with only a slim edge.

TSW's 2026 numbers look sharp, but their last three games ended in losses and their record against other regions is 1-6, which makes me wonder how steady the mood is in that room. LYON just beat them 3-0 at MSI, and their recent form is climbing, so I read their confidence as the stronger signal.
